a small box with a gold dot is a woman named in a second family. She
is drawn once in full, where her children are reckoned (or under her
father), and her box's gold line points here.
WHAT IS AND IS NOT HERE
1212 people and 38 houses; 1031 stated descents, 162 implied ones and 60 doubled lines
to a wife or mother. Every one of them reaches Adam.
The deepest line runs 59 generations, Adam to Hodaviah son of Elioenai. The small grey
number in each box is its generation from Adam, counted father to son. A wife's box has
none, and it is left off below any join where the text does not say how many generations
A person is here only if the text gives a join. Isaiah is not — “son of Amoz” joins nothing.
Zephaniah is: his four fathers run back to a Hezekiah in Josiah’s day.
City and town lists, the Hagrite war and the gatekeepers’ duty roster are left out; the
people named inside them are kept.
The canon repeats names freely and does not always agree with itself. Where two books
give one man two fathers, the chart never chooses quietly: both lines are drawn, or one
is and the box’s note gives the other.
THE TRIBES CHRONICLES WILL NOT TRACE
named among Israel’s twelve sons in 2:1-2 and then dropped. Genesis 46 gives
them four sons between them, and that is every one the canon has.
